questions.question: What format do you want for the setup?

options.label: SETUP.md (doc, copy-pasteable)
options.description: Markdown doc in ~/dev/ with commands grouped by phase. Best for parts that need interactive judgment (gh auth, IB creds, TWS install).

options.label: bootstrap.sh (executable script)
options.description: A runnable shell script that does as much as possible end-to-end. Things needing manual input get prompts or `echo` instructions.

options.label: Both
options.description: SETUP.md for the readable map + bootstrap.sh for the automatable steps. More work but clearest separation.

options.label: ~/dev/SETUP.md (loose file)
options.description: Just drop it in ~/dev/. Simple, but not version-controlled.

options.label: New private repo (jdtogni78/dev-setup)
options.description: Create a private GitHub repo so it's backed up and pullable on a new Mac with one `gh repo clone`.

options.label: Inside an existing repo
options.description: Add it to FamilyFund or dstrader's docs/ folder.

questions.question: How should TWS be set up?

options.label: Native Mac install (download from IB)
options.description: Standard route for desktop trading — user installs TWS.dmg manually from interactivebrokers.com. The dstrader README references this.

options.label: Docker (ib-gateway-docker fork)
options.description: Headless IB Gateway in Docker — you have a fork at jdtogni78/ib-gateway-docker. Better for automation/servers.

options.label: Both — native on Mac, Docker on server
options.description: Capture both since you run dstrader locally AND on the spirit server

questions.question: Anything else to include beyond what you listed?

options.label: IntelliJ + JDK setup
options.description: dstrader's README mentions IntelliJ + JDK 1.6 + TWS API relink — useful for Java dev

options.label: Python venv + playwright for fin-export
options.description: fin-export needs Python 3.10+, venv, pip install, playwright install chromium

options.label: VPN / SSH / WOL config
options.description: Connecting to jumpbox, spirit (dstrader server), wakeonlan setup

options.label: Credentials checklist (no secrets, just what's needed)
options.description: List of accounts/keys to set up: IB, Schwab API, Monarch login, GPG for backups, mail config, etc.

transcript_tail.text: allow all claude chats to monitor commands
Quick clarification — "monitor commands" could mean two different things:

Added to `~/.claude/settings.json`:

- **`Monitor`** — Claude's built-in tool for streaming output of background processes/logs
- Read-only shell commands: **tail, watch, top, htop, ps, lsof, df, du, free, uptime, netstat, ss**

The `Bash(top *)` form covers both the bare command (`top`) and with-args (`top -n1`). If you want others added (e.g., `iostat`, `vmstat`, `dmesg`), just say the word.

I want to capture all the setup necessary:

* install claude app, claude term, brew, gh, gh auth, checkout repos, docker, tws, initial commands to pull docker/build ff composer...
Let me read the existing READMEs first so the setup doc reflects the actual commands these repos need, not what I'd guess.
I've got the picture — the relevant setup commands live across the READMEs/CLAUDE.md files of each repo. A few decisions before I write the doc:
